estimand: Participant-held-out distributional discrepancy and coverage of declared club, body, hand, geometry, closure, tracking, and residual-effort observables after frozen frame, event, processing, normalization, and uncertainty rules; this is not a binary visual golf-likeness judgment.

frames.definition: Right-handed laboratory frame declared by the acquisition authority with gravity and floor-plane directions retained.
Participant-specific anatomical segment frames derived from declared landmarks and functional or static calibration.
Articulated model generalized-coordinate and body frames with an explicit laboratory-to-model transform.
Clubhead and shaft frame with declared origin, face, shaft, and swing-normal axes.
frames.transform_authority: club calibration and rigid-body marker or sensor definition

events.definition: Frozen dataset-specific transition into the downswing, reported with its detector and temporal uncertainty.
Frozen club-ball contact event from synchronized measurement or an explicitly bounded kinematic proxy.

metrics.definition: Position and orientation discrepancy of the declared club frame over normalized downswing phase.
metrics.falsifier: Held-out club poses fall outside the frozen training support after registered transform sensitivities.

metrics.definition: Linear and angular club-speed discrepancy, peak timing, and coverage over normalized downswing phase.
metrics.falsifier: Held-out speed magnitudes or peak timing reject the frozen training distribution under registered processing sensitivities.

metrics.definition: Pelvis orientation and angular-rate discrepancy in the declared anatomical and laboratory frames.
metrics.falsifier: Held-out pelvis orientation or rate lies outside frozen support after coordinate and filtering sensitivities.

metrics.definition: Thorax orientation and angular-rate discrepancy in the declared anatomical and laboratory frames.
metrics.falsifier: Held-out thorax orientation or rate lies outside frozen support after coordinate and filtering sensitivities.

metrics.definition: Ordering and separation of pelvis, thorax, arm, and club angular-speed peaks without equating their order to energy flow.
metrics.falsifier: The analytic authority's ordering or peak separations are uncommon or reversed in participant-held-out trials.

metrics.definition: Bilateral hand paths and measured wrist coordinates over normalized downswing phase.
metrics.falsifier: Held-out bilateral hand paths or wrist coordinates reject the frozen measured support.

metrics.definition: Relative pelvis, thorax, arm, forearm, hand, and club orientations and declared length ratios.
metrics.falsifier: Relative orientations or scaled lengths place analytic states outside participant-held-out geometric support.

metrics.definition: Minimum distance between mapped generalized coordinates and declared participant or model joint limits.
metrics.falsifier: Mapped held-out states cross declared limits or lose the preregistered positive margin under sensitivity.

metrics.definition: Bilateral distance between mapped anatomical hand contact points and declared club grip points.
metrics.falsifier: Closure residual exceeds its frozen tolerance or becomes sensitive to plausible frame and marker perturbations.

metrics.definition: Difference between held-out measured coordinates and mapped replay or constrained-tracking coordinates under frozen weights.
metrics.falsifier: Participant-held-out tracking residuals exceed frozen support or change conclusion under registered processing choices.

metrics.definition: Residual generalized force required to reproduce mapped measured acceleration after declared inertial, gravity, contact, and external-load terms.
metrics.falsifier: Held-out residual effort is implausibly large, structurally biased, or unstable under registered differentiation and scaling sensitivities.

negative_controls.transformation: Permute within-trial phase blocks while preserving marginal channel values and participant identity.
negative_controls.pass_condition: Frozen multichannel timing and path metrics classify every manufactured phase-scrambled trial outside qualified support.

negative_controls.transformation: Reverse declared velocity channels while retaining the same sampled configurations and event window.
negative_controls.pass_condition: Frozen direction, timing, and dynamic-consistency metrics reject every reversed-velocity trial.

negative_controls.transformation: Apply an out-of-domain body-to-club and segment-length scale while preserving normalized phase.
negative_controls.pass_condition: Frozen geometry, feasibility, closure, and tracking metrics reject every registered scale mismatch.

negative_controls.transformation: Use a deterministic non-golf multisegment trajectory with valid shapes, units, and finite values.
negative_controls.pass_condition: The frozen primary kinematic metric set rejects the manufactured non-golf trajectory despite schema validity.

uncertainty_analyses.perturbation: Shift synchronized channels and event anchors over the governed timing-uncertainty interval.
uncertainty_analyses.decision_rule: Retain the full classification range; any support reversal makes the affected conclusion inconclusive.

uncertainty_analyses.perturbation: Repeat registered differentiation and smoothing alternatives without selecting them from held-out results.
uncertainty_analyses.decision_rule: Retain all alternatives and fail promotion when sign, support, or failure class is processing-dependent.

uncertainty_analyses.perturbation: Perturb laboratory, anatomical, model, and club transforms within calibrated uncertainty.
uncertainty_analyses.decision_rule: Require classification stability or report the affected metric as transform-unidentified.

uncertainty_analyses.perturbation: Propagate declared marker, keypoint, occlusion, and rigid-body reconstruction uncertainty.
uncertainty_analyses.decision_rule: Require coverage conclusions to survive the complete retained reconstruction ensemble.

uncertainty_analyses.perturbation: Vary downswing-start and impact anchors over their governed detector uncertainty.
uncertainty_analyses.decision_rule: Require timing and peak-order conclusions to survive every registered event realization.

uncertainty_analyses.perturbation: Propagate measured and estimator uncertainty in segment lengths, mass properties, joint centers, and club dimensions.
uncertainty_analyses.decision_rule: Require geometry, range, tracking, and effort classifications to remain stable or report them as scaling-dependent.

inference_boundary: This motion-only preregistration cannot establish bilateral wrench allocation, interaction-force causality, muscle or scapular intent, passive human negative torque, performance optimality, injury risk, or coaching guidance; synthetic controls qualify only software discrimination.
